headline: Result Update

highlights: Important Data During Q2FY27, the company reported revenue growth of 12% YoY to ₹16,100crs in Q2FY27, driven by strong performance in India formulations (+17.3%), Emerging Markets (+7.6%) and Global Innovative Medicines (+6.9%).

EBITDA grew flattish by 4.8% YoY to ₹4,744crs, with EBITDA margin declining to 29.3% from 31.4% in Q2FY26, despite gross margin improvement to 80.8% from 79.8%, due to higher employee and other expenses.

Management indicated that excluding the impact of lenalidomide sales in the Q1FY26, Reported PAT declined 36% YoY to ₹1,989crs, primarily due to exceptional expenses of ₹1,269crs towards litigation settlement and Organon acquisition-related costs.

Growth was driven by Illumya, Cequa and Odomzo across the US and international markets. • Illumya received US approval for active psoriatic arthritis, with a soft launch planned in November 2026 and full launch over the following months. • Illumya witnessed a slowdown in the US due to a combination of market-related factors and execution issues.
valuation: Its strong specialty portfolio, leading India business and growth opportunities from Organon support its premium valuation.
